source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.growth_habit: Shrub or small tree to ca. 12 m
morphology_source_reported.branches: Green, prominently armed with sharp spines
morphology_source_reported.leaves: Bipinnately compound with 2(–4) pinnae; green flattened pinna rachis; leaflets 2–5(–9) mm long
morphology_source_reported.fruits: Usually 5–10 cm long, constricted between seeds

habitat_source_reported: Low sandy or gravelly limestone areas
cautions: Flora explicitly describes uncertainty about whether Texas populations are indigenous or adventive; BONAP county nativity requires separate review
Historical taxon concept requires reconciliation before identification-scoring use
Regional habitat does not establish local BONAP nativity
